dispositions.void: pre-final invalidation without an irreversible external effect
dispositions.reverse: append-only correction of an existing financial event

invariants: posted or settled truth is never cancelled or voided
refunds require confirmed outgoing settlement evidence
cumulative refunds cannot exceed active original incoming settlement value
dedicated correction types are used when the catalog defines them
writeoffs equal the exact outstanding obligation and transition it atomically
chargebacks remain provider adjustments and never rewrite customer payment truth
material corrections preserve immutable document identity and evidence hash
all authorities are tenant and organization scoped
replay is deterministic and conflicts are rejected
every financial correction is posted as a balanced journal
forbidden: deleting or updating original financial events
